messages:
Maya Patel: Quick copy check — we changed the overflow menu tooltip from 'More' to 'More actions' but it's still vague when read by a screen reader. Thoughts?
Samir Khan: Yeah I noticed that. For keyboard users the ellipsis button is just 'button' in VoiceOver right now.
Rachel Li: Oof. Do we have the actual aria-label on that element? I thought we added one.
Maya Patel: Frontend shows <button class="row-ellipsis">…</button> no aria-label.
Samir Khan: That explains it. Suggestion: use aria-label="More actions for {rowName}" so it reads context.
Evan Torres: Agree. Maybe shorter: "Row actions: {rowName}"? keeps it concise for SRs.
Rachel Li: I prefer "More actions for {rowName}" since it matches visual copy. Consistency matters for testing.
Maya Patel: Also for sighted users the tooltip shows 'More actions' but when you tab it doesn't announce anything. So aria-label + title would fix both.
Samir Khan: Implementation nit: don't duplicate visible text in title if we already have aria-labelledby pointing to the row header. Simpler to set aria-label directly.
Rachel Li: Accessibility nit: avoid using just the row id. Use human-readable name and truncate if too long. E.g., "More actions for model 'Searcher'" vs "More actions for model 'Searcher...very-long'"
Maya Patel: Good call. Also copy tweak — for the empty prompt-set state on the Eval page, current CTA is 'Create'. Sounds meh. Suggestions?
Evan Torres: 'Create prompt set' is explicit. Or 'Add prompt set' feels lower friction.
Samir Khan: I'd vote 'Add your first prompt set' for the empty-state header and keep CTA 'Add prompt set'.
Rachel Li: Language should reflect next step: 'Add prompt set' + small subtext: 'Use these prompts to track latency and quality across changes.'
Maya Patel: Nice. For the error toast we had: 'Request failed, try again later.' Some customers hit transient rate limits and we lose context. Recommend: 'Unable to save — you may be rate limited. Try again in a few seconds or contact support.' Shorter option: 'Save failed — try again or contact support.'
Samir Khan: Lean toward the short one in the toast and expand in the error panel. Toast = action: 'Save failed — try again' with button 'Contact support'.
Rachel Li: Also add an inline link to docs for rate limit best practices in the error detail view.
Maya Patel: One more microcopy piece: confirmation dialog when deleting a model variant. Current dialog title: 'Delete?'. Can we make it clearer and lower accidental deletes: title 'Delete model variant' and body 'This will remove variant "v2-quant" from serving. Existing routes will fall back to the default model.' Button labels: primary = 'Delete variant', secondary = 'Cancel' (not 'Close').
Evan Torres: Strong +1 on explicit primary label. Helps audit logs and keyboard explorers.
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist update: "Ensure all ellipsis buttons have aria-labels, tooltips are accessible on focus, toasts include short actionable copy, confirmation dialogs use explicit primary action labels."
Maya Patel: Great. Samir can you make the PR with: aria-label update, tooltip title add, empty-state CTA change, toast copy tweak, and delete dialog copy? Small CSS/JS changes only.
Samir Khan: Yep. I'll include examples in the PR description and a before/after screen reader test. ETA EOD.
Rachel Li: I'll review copy in PR and run the a11y test scripts.
Evan Torres: Ping me for confirm dialog behavior — I'll test keyboard/mouse/voiceover flows.
Maya Patel: Thanks all :sparkles:
